mapper.select: SELECT id, project_id, title, total_episodes, story_synopsis, characters_json, source_type, parsing_status, parsing_progress, summary, genre, target_audience, duration_estimate, ai_generated, status, version, create_time, update_time, COALESCE(CHAR_LENGTH(raw_content), 0) AS raw_content_length FROM afv_script WHERE id = #{id} AND deleted = 0

SELECT id, script_id, episode_number, title, synopsis, duration_estimate, total_scenes, source_type, sort_order, parsing_status, status, version, create_time, update_time, COALESCE(CHAR_LENGTH(raw_content), 0) AS raw_content_length FROM afv_script_episode WHERE script_id = #{scriptId} AND deleted = 0 ORDER BY sort_order, id
